paragraphs.text: Photo-real desk pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four personas, expressions + actions, proactive spe

# dsh-pet

A little companion that lives in the bottom-right corner of the **DSH web UI**: it stays
around or d

rops in at random, talks (with voice), walks, dances, gets shy or annoyed, and
carries a tiny input

box you can chat with. Five photo-realistic personas, each with its
own temper.

> Scope: the pet only lives inside the DSH window (it mounts into the framework's overlay
> slot). I

t **cannot float above other applications** — that would need a separate Electron
> shell rather tha

float above other applications** — that would need a separate Electron
> shell rather than a plugin.
## At a glance

- **Languages**: UI chrome, persona taglines and the chat system prompt follow the browser
interface

language — shipped for `en / zh / es / pt / hi` (`locale/*.json`, namespace
`pet`; slots register w

ith `locale: 'pet'` per the DSH slot contract). Each persona also
ships an English line pack, so a n
on-Chinese UI hears English lines.

- **Mount points**: `shell.overlay` (the pet itself, a click-through layer) and
`conversation.input.

right` (the entry button next to the composer).
- **Private chat**: what you type in the small box *

*never enters your session**. The host
half exposes `POST /dsh-pet/chat` and answers with a one-shot

`ctx.llm.stream()` call
(no session, no session log). Defaults: `deepseek-account` / `deepseek-flas

h`; provider,
model, maxTokens and temperature are plugin config.
- **Icon**: `icon.svg` (the rose s

ilhouette) and the composer button share the same path.
- **Settings panel**: grouped (look / voice

/ display / actions / effects), custom dropdowns
(native `<select>` popups are system-white and unre

adable in dark themes) and custom
switches; it is placed relative to the pet (above her, or to her l

eft when there is no
room) and clamped into the viewport under the header.
- **Five personas** (phot

o-realistic, same lighting; **all five** ship 5 expressions
each: default / happy / shy / angry / sl

eepy): 薇 (violet), 绯 (crimson), 靛 (indigo),
雪 (silver), plus 鲸鱼娘 (azure) — a whale-fin maid whose ex

pression set was added in
1.23.0, with its own walk / dance / hair clips. Expression changes cross-f

ade (180 ms)
instead of hard-cutting.
- **Action sequences**: a persona may declare `actions: { danc

e: [...], hair: [...],
walk: [...] }`; each set is 3–6 frames (3-frame sets step at 340 ms, 6-frame

each stylised to the character; newer personas may instead ship
video clips (VP9 + alpha), and a cl

ip's own length decides how long the action lives.
- **Adding artwork**: drop transparent PNGs into

`assets/` and reference them from
[该节后续省略]
## Behavior
| Capability | How |
| Always-on / random | Toggle in the panel; random mode rolls a per-hour probability inside the acti

ve window |
| Active hours | Start/end time, supports crossing midnight (22:00 → 03:00) |
| Proactiv

e lines | Per-mood line packs, bubble + speech |
| Voice | **Optional**: if the host has any python
with `edge-tts`, `/dsh-pet/tts` synthesises (cached) and `/dsh-pet/tts/status` probes it; otherwise

it falls back to the system `speechSynthesis`. The plugin itself has zero runtime dependencies |
| S
mall input box | **Hidden by default; slides out when you hover the character** (since 1.22.0, and m
oving from the character onto the box does not dismiss it). Turn off "Only on hover" in settings to

pin it. Messages go to the pet only; one-shot model call, nothing is written to any DSH session |
|

Moods | idle / walk / dance / shy / angry / sleep / talk / happy |
| Dragging | 60% chance of a `dra

g` line once you drop it; all five personas have them (completed in 1.24.0), five languages |
| Inne
r voice | A low-frequency (7%) grey aside — a thought, never spoken; only for personas that declare

`lines.aside`; all five have them (1.24.0) |
| Gaze | Pupils follow the mouse (CSS variables only, n

o re-render) |
| Effects | Ink / confetti / cloud / fog (wipable) / bomb + cracked screen |
| Event

hooks | Confetti after a turn longer than 4 s; a cloud appears after a failed tool call |
| Temper |

Per-persona weight table decides what it does more of |
| Hide | "Hide for 1 h" in the panel |

Published as `dsh-pet-plugin` on npm; it also installs straight from a folder.

le:<this dir>"` to the profile, registers the bundle, runs
`pnpm install`, then reads back all four

## Security model

- The host routes are gated three ways, none of them tied to a fixed port or domain:
`Host` must be

a loopback address, the host's own origin, or listed in the
`allowedHosts` plugin config (for revers

e-proxy / LAN deployments); a present
`Origin` must be same-origin with that `Host` or the desktop s

hell
(`dsh-app://app`, `dsh-app://shell`); and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, when present, must be
`same-origin`

or `none`. Non-browser clients that send none of these are allowed —
that is the deliberate limit o

f a local HTTP endpoint, see below.
- Speech synthesis is a `POST` endpoint that returns the audio b

ytes; there is no
GET URL to feed to an `<audio src>`, so a page (or another local process) cannot m

ake
the host synthesise anything by pointing an element at it.
- Synthesised speech is cached in the

OS temp dir with a size cap that is re-checked
after every synthesis, and writes go through a rando

m temp name + rename so a
pre-planted symlink cannot redirect them.
- Anything the page sends (setti

ngs, chat history, persona id) is treated as data:
validated, length-capped, and never interpolated

as instructions or markup.
- Neural voice sends the spoken text to Microsoft's edge-tts endpoint. Tu

rn it off
(or never install `edge-tts`) to keep everything local; the panel says so.
